Title: Pratibha — OpenRouter API Key
Notes / how to get: Powers Study Chat (and can power embeddings). openrouter.ai → Keys.

Title: Pratibha — OpenAI API Key (embeddings)
Notes / how to get: Preferred for RAG embeddings (text-embedding-3-small). Optional if OpenRouter used for embeddings.

Title: Pratibha — Default chat model
Notes / how to get: Keep openrouter/ prefix. Cheap/fast default.

Title: Pratibha — OpenRouter model (alias)
Notes / how to get: Fallback / alias for default model.

Title: Pratibha — Chat model simple
Notes / how to get: Empty = DEFAULT_MODEL. Used for chat_mode=question.

Title: Pratibha — Chat model deep
Notes / how to get: Empty = DEFAULT_MODEL. Set Sonnet id when you want stronger explain/compare/practice.

Title: Pratibha — Chat daily max
Notes / how to get: Soft daily messages per IP/user. 0 disables.

Title: Pratibha — Chat simple max tokens
Notes / how to get: Shorter completions for simple routing.

Title: Pratibha — Chat rate per minute
Notes / how to get: Per-IP sliding window. 0 disables.

Title: Pratibha — Chat max tokens
Notes / how to get: Default completion budget.

Title: Pratibha — Request timeout seconds
Notes / how to get: LLM request timeout.

Title: Pratibha — Max retries
Notes / how to get: LLM retries.

Title: Pratibha — OpenRouter site URL
Notes / how to get: HTTP-Referer for OpenRouter rankings.

Title: Pratibha — OpenRouter app name
Notes / how to get: X-Title header for OpenRouter.

Title: Pratibha — Embedding model
Notes / how to get: Must match ingest dimensionality (1536).

Title: Pratibha — USE_RAG
Notes / how to get: true for Study Chat retrieval in production.

Title: Pratibha — VECTOR_BACKEND
Notes / how to get: pgvector only in current stack.

Title: Pratibha — RAG_FETCH_K
Notes / how to get: Candidate pool size before filtering.

Title: Pratibha — RAG_MIN_SCORE
Notes / how to get: Minimum similarity for RAG hits.

Title: Pratibha — DATABASE_URL
Where to set: Render (auto from pratibha-db) + local .env for ingest
Notes / how to get: Postgres+pgvector connection string. Use Internal URL on Render; External + PG_SSL for laptop ingest.

Title: Pratibha — PG_SSL
Where to set: local .env when using public DB URL
Notes / how to get: true for managed DB over public internet.

Title: Pratibha — CORS allow origins
Notes / how to get: Low
column10: Comma-separated frontend origins. No spaces preferred.

Title: Pratibha — Admin token
Notes / how to get: Gates GET /admin/corpus-status via X-Admin-Token header.

Title: Pratibha — Supabase project URL
Notes / how to get: Supabase → Project Settings → API → Project URL. Same project as NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.

Title: Pratibha — Supabase JWT secret
Notes / how to get: Supabase → Project Settings → API → JWT Secret. NOT the anon or service_role key (those start with eyJ).

Title: Pratibha — Supabase service role key
Where to set: local/admin only — NEVER ship to web client
Notes / how to get: Bypasses RLS. Only for trusted server scripts. Do not put in Cloudflare/Next public env.

Title: Pratibha — Web API base (prod)
Notes / how to get: Baked at Next build time. No trailing slash. Redeploy web after change.

Title: Pratibha — Web site URL (prod)
Notes / how to get: Canonical site / metadata base.

Title: Pratibha — Web Supabase URL (public)
Notes / how to get: Same as SUPABASE_URL. Safe in client bundle.

Title: Pratibha — Web Supabase anon key (public)
Notes / how to get: Supabase → API → anon public key. Safe in client; still share only with trusted colleagues.

Title: Pratibha — Web API base (local)
Notes / how to get: Use development.local — never put localhost in .env.local or prod builds break.

Title: Pratibha — FAL image key
Notes / how to get: Only for fal.ai art generation scripts — not required to run the app.

Title: Pratibha — Groq API key (legacy)
Notes / how to get: Ignored for chat. Can omit for new colleagues.

Title: Pratibha — Mobile API base
Notes / how to get: e.g. http://192.168.x.x:8000 for Expo on physical phone.

Title: Pratibha — Render service
Notes / how to get: Colleague needs Render access or you paste env values for them.

Title: Pratibha — Render Postgres
Notes / how to get: Copy from Render → pratibha-db → Connections.

Title: Pratibha — Cloudflare Pages/Workers
Notes / how to get: Frontend deploy: cd web && npm run deploy.

Title: Pratibha — GitHub repo
Notes / how to get: Branch used for Render deploy: cursor/study-notes-layer-labels-chuang-cleanup (see render.yaml).

Title: Pratibha — Supabase project access
Notes / how to get: Auth providers: Email + Google. Redirect URLs must include https://pratibha.agniagama.com/auth/callback and http://localhost:3000/auth/callback.

Title: Pratibha — Production API health
Notes / how to get: Expect JSON with ready/items after warm.

Title: Pratibha — Production site
Notes / how to get: Custom domain on Cloudflare Worker.

Title: Pratibha — Local backend start
Notes / how to get: From repo root: source .venv; uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 (or project scripts/dev.sh).

Title: Pratibha — Local web start
Notes / how to get: cd web && npm install && npm run dev (uses .env.development.local).

Title: Pratibha — One-time pgvector ingest
Notes / how to get: See DEPLOY.md — needs embedding key + DATABASE_URL; same EMBEDDING_MODEL as API.
